ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.label: keeper of secrets
ColonyCouncil.OfficeDef.description: Keeps what the colony knows and what it would rather others didn't: hears what visitors let slip, keeps an eye on guests after dark, and holds the colony's own confidences close.

duties.li: While the seat is filled, the colony's own secrets slip half as often.
After dark, with guests of another people on the colony's land, walks with them a while, and now and then overhears something about one of their notables.
Can sound out someone of another people face to face, and remind a notable of what the colony knows about them.
On the council's task, learns a chosen notable's secret through their people's visits, a paid informer or a visit to their town. Found out one time in ten.
Opens once the colony has six people who can vote.

elected.li: {PAWN_nameDef} said very little after the count, which several people took as a good sign.
{PAWN_nameDef} has started a small notebook and keeps it in an inside pocket.
{PAWN_nameDef} already knew how most of the votes would go, and didn't say how.

li.text: {PAWN_nameDef} says the last raiders knew the colony's weak side too well, and promises to know friends at the gate from those who carry tales.
{PAWN_nameDef} promises a quiet watch on every guest after dark, and nothing said in confidence let slip.
